entity: Medicare Diabetes Prevention Program uptake among suppliers and patients, 2024
what_we_add: 37 suppliers billing 11+ patients in 2024, 1,267 patients, $347,437 total, ~3,800 patient ceiling
why: CMS's own evaluation states limited participation (under 10,000 beneficiaries ever, RTI: 9,015 through March 2024) and AJMC notes only a third of suppliers ever billed. Same finding, same direction; the 2024 supplier/dollar counts are ours alone.
